_comment: The Attack Surface Reduction rules NRG requires, every one in Block mode. SHIPS EMPTY ON PURPOSE: the tool does not invent NRG's standard. Add entries as { "Id": "<rule key or a distinctive part of it, lower-case>", "Name": "<display name>" }. The Id is matched against the rule key read from the Settings Catalog policy (the setting definition id after 'attacksurfacereductionrules_'). Until this list is approved, INT-2.2 reports the modes read and leaves the rule-set half not assessed.
